item.title: AMDP Service Unavailable - Paris Data Center (Cluster D) [resolved]
item.description:
Customer Impact: AMDP customers may experience minor latency with real-time scanning of files and content while services are failed over to a redundant data center.
Current Status : We have identified the problem to be related to one of our malware sandboxing providers. We have receive confirmation from the Vendor on stability of their infrastructure and have re-balanced AMDP services across Paris and San Jose.
This incident has been resolved.
